airspace.zh: 德國依歐盟規則：一般「開放類」限高120公尺、須目視飛行並投保責任險；重量250公克以上或有相機的無人機須向聯邦航空局（LBA）登記。自然保護區、聯邦水道等地另有地理區限制，實際飛行前請查DFS／dipul地圖。
airspace.en: Germany follows the EU rules: in the Open category fly at most 120 m high, within sight and with liability insurance; drones over 250 g or with a camera must be registered with the LBA. Nature reserves, federal waterways and other geographical zones have extra limits; check the DFS/dipul map before flying.

lorelei.note: 132 m slate rock on the right bank at Sankt Goarshausen

pfalz.note: toll castle on Falkenau island at Kaub

deutsches_eck.note: confluence of Rhine and Moselle at Koblenz (Wikidata Q700785)

mouse_tower.note: tower on an island at Binger Loch (Wikidata Q521497)

title.en: A River of Castles and Tolls

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩千年的貿易水道，四十多座山頂城堡怎麼來
tagline.en: Two thousand years of river trade, and where the forty hilltop castles came from

zh: 這裡是萊茵河中上游河谷的南端，
賓根與呂德斯海姆之間。
en: This is the southern end of the Upper Middle Rhine Valley,
between Bingen and Rüdesheim.

zh: 河谷從這裡往北約六十五公里，一路到科布倫茨。
en: From here the valley runs north for about 65 kilometres to Koblenz.

zh: 兩千年來，這條河連接地中海世界與北歐，
是一條重要的貿易路線。
en: For two thousand years the river has linked the Mediterranean
with northern Europe as a major trade route.

zh: 河邊的財富，
讓兩岸山頭蓋起了大約四十座城堡。
en: Wealth from the river
raised some forty hilltop castles along its banks.

zh: 國王、諸侯、伯爵與主教在這裡築城，
向往來的船隻收取關稅。
en: Kings, princes, counts and bishops built castles here
and levied tolls on passing boats.

zh: 河中央的普法爾茨城堡，
1327年由行宮伯爵路德維希四世開始興建。
en: Pfalzgrafenstein, in mid-river,
was begun in 1327 by Count Palatine Ludwig IV.

zh: 它是萊茵河上最賺錢的關卡之一，
當時的教宗與主教都表示反對。
en: It was part of one of the most lucrative toll stations on the Rhine;
the pope and bishops of the day objected.

zh: 1504年，它撐過三十九天的圍城，毫髮無傷。
en: In 1504 it withstood a siege of 39 days unscathed.

zh: 三十年戰爭之後，
許多城堡只剩下廢墟。
en: After the Thirty Years' War
many of the castles were left in ruins.

zh: 河谷曾是神聖羅馬帝國的核心地區，
也曾是法國的邊界。
en: The valley was a core region of the Holy Roman Empire
and was once the French border.

zh: 十九世紀，這裡併入普魯士。
en: In the nineteenth century it became part of Prussia.

zh: 布勞巴赫上方的馬克斯堡，
1231年首次見於文獻。
en: The Marksburg above Braubach
is first mentioned in documents in 1231.

zh: 它是河谷中少數從未被摧毀的山頂城堡，
1931年起是德國城堡協會的總部。
en: It is one of the few hilltop castles here never destroyed;
since 1931 it has housed the German Castles Association.

zh: 2002年，這段河谷列入世界遺產，
終點就在科布倫茨的德意志角。
en: In 2002 the valley was inscribed as World Heritage;
it ends at the Deutsches Eck in Koblenz.

tagline.zh-Hant: 從船難傳說到浪漫主義：詩人、作曲家與河上的節慶
tagline.en: From shipwreck stories to Romanticism: poets, composers and river festivals

zh: 聖戈阿爾斯豪森旁的這塊岩石，
叫做羅蕾萊。
en: This rock beside Sankt Goarshausen
is the Lorelei.

zh: 它是一百三十二公尺高的板岩，
矗立在萊茵河右岸。
en: It is a slate rock 132 metres high,
standing on the right bank of the Rhine.

zh: 從十世紀有紀錄開始，
這一段河道就以船難出名。
en: Since the first records in the tenth century
this stretch has been notorious for shipwrecks.

zh: 名字可能來自方言的「低語」與「岩石」，
湍流的聲音在岩壁間回響。
en: The name may join dialect words for "murmuring" and "rock":
the sound of the current echoed off the cliff.

zh: 1801年，布倫塔諾寫下羅蕾萊的敘事詩。
en: In 1801 Clemens Brentano wrote a ballad of the Lorelei.

zh: 1824年，海涅把她寫成唱歌的女子，
歌聲讓船夫撞上岩石。
en: In 1824 Heinrich Heine made her a singing figure
whose song drew boatmen onto the rocks.

zh: 1837年，西爾歇為海涅的詩譜曲，
這首歌傳遍德語地區。
en: In 1837 Friedrich Silcher set Heine's poem to music,
and the song spread across the German-speaking lands.

zh: 岩頂有一座1930年代的露天劇場。
en: On top of the rock is an open-air amphitheatre from the 1930s.

zh: 羅蕾萊岩成了萊茵浪漫主義的象徵。
en: The Lorelei became a symbol of Rhine Romanticism.

zh: 每年九月在聖戈阿爾、八月在科布倫茨，
河上會放「萊茵河焰火」。
en: Every September at Sankt Goar and August at Koblenz
the "Rhine in Flames" fireworks light the river.

zh: 河谷兩旁有萊茵城堡步道、
萊茵石階步道等健行路線。
en: Walking routes such as the Rhine Castles Trail
and the Rheinsteig follow the valley.

zh: 沿河有三十多個城鎮與村莊，
從科布倫茨一路到呂德斯海姆。
en: More than thirty towns and villages line the river,
from Koblenz to Rüdesheim.

zh: 萊茵河上最後一艘明輪蒸汽船，
名叫「歌德號」。
en: The last paddle steamer on the Rhine
is called the "Goethe".

zh: 一塊岩石、一首詩、一首歌，
讓這段河谷成了浪漫的代名詞。
en: One rock, one poem and one song
made this valley a byword for Romanticism.

tagline.zh-Hant: 峽谷裡的微氣候、梯田葡萄園與一條物種走廊
tagline.en: The microclimate of the gorge, its terraced vineyards and a corridor for wildlife

zh: 從空中看，河谷兩側是陡坡，
坡上一層層是葡萄梯田。
en: From the air the valley sides are steep,
stepped with terraced vineyards.

zh: 梯田沿著山坡修築，
朝南的坡面最適合種葡萄。
en: The terraces follow the slopes;
south-facing ones suit the vines best.

zh: 這裡大多屬於中萊茵葡萄酒產區。
en: Most of these vineyards belong to the Mittelrhein wine region.

zh: 河谷南端的葡萄園，
分屬萊茵高與那赫產區。
en: At the southern end
the vineyards belong to the Rheingau and Nahe regions.

zh: 呂德斯海姆上方，
整片山坡幾乎都是葡萄園。
en: Above Rüdesheim
whole hillsides are covered in vines.

zh: 梯田的線條，
順著等高線排成一道道弧線。
en: The lines of the terraces
curve along the contours.

zh: 峽谷有自己的微氣候，
和周圍的高地不一樣。
en: The gorge has its own microclimate,
different from the uplands around it.

zh: 河谷也像一條走廊，
讓區域裡原本沒有的物種沿河擴散。
en: The valley also works as a corridor
for species not otherwise found in the region.

zh: 河水低的時候，
普法爾茨城堡曾因水位太低而暫停開放。
en: When the river runs low
Pfalzgrafenstein has had to close for lack of water.

zh: 往北，是羅蕾萊岩。
en: Further north is the Lorelei.

zh: 從空中看，岩壁陡直地落到河邊。
en: From the air, the rock face drops steeply to the river.

zh: 再往北，城堡立在河谷的高處。
en: Further north, castles stand high above the valley.

zh: 到了科布倫茨，摩澤爾河從西邊匯入萊茵河。
en: At Koblenz the Moselle joins the Rhine from the west.

zh: 陽光、坡度與河水，
讓峽谷成了葡萄與人共同經營的地景。
en: Sun, slope and river
made the gorge a landscape shaped by vines and people together.

tagline.zh-Hant: 泥盆紀的板岩、地殼抬升與兩百公尺深的峽谷
tagline.en: Devonian slate, uplift and a gorge two hundred metres deep

zh: 賓根附近的這個河口，
是萊茵峽谷的南大門。
en: This narrows near Bingen
is the southern gateway to the Rhine Gorge.

zh: 一側是河中小島上的鼠塔，
另一側是埃倫費爾斯城堡。
en: On one side is the Mouse Tower on its island,
on the other Burg Ehrenfels.

zh: 從上面看，河流在這裡轉進狹窄的峽谷。
en: From above, the river here turns into the narrow gorge.

zh: 兩岸的岩石，
在泥盆紀時沉積在海底。
en: The rocks on both banks
were laid down on a sea floor in the Devonian.

zh: 這些沉積岩含有化石，
主要是板岩。
en: These sedimentary rocks carry fossils
and are mostly slate.

zh: 石炭紀時，岩層被擠壓摺曲。
en: In the Carboniferous the layers were folded.

zh: 後來地殼抬升，河流一邊往下切，
切出今天的峽谷。
en: Later the land rose and the river cut down
into it, carving the gorge we see today.

zh: 峽谷的岩壁高達兩百公尺。
en: The walls of the gorge reach 200 metres.

zh: 羅蕾萊岩是峽谷最有名的地形，
一百三十二公尺的板岩直落河邊。
en: The Lorelei is the gorge's most famous landform:
slate dropping 132 metres to the river.

zh: 2011年1月，一艘載運兩千四百噸硫酸的貨船
在這附近翻覆，阻斷了航道。
en: In January 2011 a barge carrying 2,400 tonnes of sulphuric acid
capsized near here and blocked the waterway.

zh: 往北，河道仍然窄窄地夾在山之間。
en: Northwards the river stays narrow between the hills.

zh: 世界遺產核心區兩萬七千二百五十公頃，
緩衝區三萬四千六百八十公頃。
en: The World Heritage core covers 27,250 hectares,
the buffer zone 34,680 hectares.

zh: 峽谷在科布倫茨打開，
萊茵河與摩澤爾河在德意志角交會。
en: The gorge opens out at Koblenz,
where Rhine and Moselle meet at the Deutsches Eck.

zh: 抬升的板岩山地，與一條不停下切的河，
造出這段六十五公里的峽谷。
en: Rising slate uplands and a river that kept cutting down
made these 65 kilometres of gorge.
